questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the system of government by the people'?
explanation: Democracy is correct - D-E-M-O-C-R-A-C-Y. Democracy is a system of government where citizens elect leaders.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a person who makes laws'?
explanation: Legislator is correct - L-E-G-I-S-L-A-T-O-R. A legislator is a member of a legislative body who makes laws.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the head of state in a republic'?
explanation: President is correct - P-R-E-S-I-D-E-N-T. A president is the elected head of a republic.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a legal document of basic laws'?
explanation: Constitution is correct - C-O-N-S-T-I-T-U-T-I-O-N. A constitution is a set of fundamental laws governing a country.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to choose leaders by voting'?
explanation: Elect is correct - E-L-E-C-T. To elect means to choose someone by voting.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a group of people who make laws'?
explanation: Parliament is correct - P-A-R-L-I-A-M-E-N-T. A parliament is the highest law-making body in a country.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'freedom from being controlled'?
explanation: Independence is correct - I-N-D-E-P-E-N-D-E-N-C-E. Independence means freedom from control or rule.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a formal agreement between nations'?
explanation: Treaty is correct - T-R-E-A-T-Y. A treaty is a formal agreement between countries.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the power to make decisions'?
explanation: Authority is correct - A-U-T-H-O-R-I-T-Y. Authority is the power to make decisions or give orders.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a person sent to represent a country'?
explanation: Ambassador is correct - A-M-B-A-S-S-A-D-O-R. An ambassador is a diplomat who represents one country in another. Double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the right to vote'?
explanation: Suffrage is correct - S-U-F-F-R-A-G-E. Suffrage is the right to vote in elections. Double F.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a state of conflict between nations'?
explanation: Warfare is correct - W-A-R-F-A-R-E. Warfare refers to the conduct of military conflict between states.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'loyalty to one nation'?
explanation: Nationalism is correct - N-A-T-I-O-N-A-L-I-S-M. Nationalism is strong loyalty and pride in one country.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a government where one person rules absolutely'?
explanation: Dictatorship is correct - D-I-C-T-A-T-O-R-S-H-I-P. A dictatorship is ruled by a single person with total authority.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the process of voting'?
explanation: Election is correct - E-L-E-C-T-I-O-N. An election is the formal process by which voters choose candidates.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a representative of a district'?
explanation: Delegate is correct - D-E-L-E-G-A-T-E. A delegate is a person chosen to represent others.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the practice of managing relations between countries'?
explanation: Diplomacy is correct - D-I-P-L-O-M-A-C-Y. Diplomacy is the management of international relations.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the body of laws of a country'?
explanation: Legislation is correct - L-E-G-I-S-L-A-T-I-O-N. Legislation refers to laws made by a governing body.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'freedom from being held prisoner without cause'?
explanation: Habeas corpus is correct - H-A-B-E-A-S C-O-R-P-U-S. It is a legal principle protecting against unlawful detention.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a document giving rights to citizens'?
explanation: Charter is correct - C-H-A-R-T-E-R. A charter is a written document granting rights and privileges.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to cancel a law'?
explanation: Repeal is correct - R-E-P-E-A-L. To repeal means to revoke or cancel a law.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the rights belonging to all citizens'?
explanation: Civil rights is correct - C-I-V-I-L R-I-G-H-T-S. Civil rights are the rights of all citizens to equality and freedom.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a group that checks the power of government'?
explanation: Opposition is correct - O-P-P-O-S-I-T-I-O-N. Double P. The opposition is the party that challenges the ruling party.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a meeting of a governing body'?
explanation: Session is correct - S-E-S-S-I-O-N. A session is a meeting of a law-making body. Double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a person who runs for office'?
explanation: Candidate is correct - C-A-N-D-I-D-A-T-E. A candidate is a person who seeks election to public office.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the act of forming a new state'?
explanation: Proclamation is correct - P-R-O-C-L-A-M-A-T-I-O-N. A proclamation is an official public announcement.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a political system based on equality'?
explanation: Socialism is correct - S-O-C-I-A-L-I-S-M. Socialism is an economic and political system advocating collective ownership.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'an alliance of states under one central government'?
explanation: Federation is correct - F-E-D-E-R-A-T-I-O-N. A federation is a union of partially self-governing states under a central authority.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the right to self-governance'?
explanation: Autonomy is correct - A-U-T-O-N-O-M-Y. Autonomy is the right of a country or region to govern itself.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the separation of powers in government'?
explanation: Checks and balances is correct - C-H-E-C-K-S A-N-D B-A-L-A-N-C-E-S. It is the system dividing power among branches of government.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a formal protest or strong objection'?
explanation: Demonstration is correct - D-E-M-O-N-S-T-R-A-T-I-O-N. A demonstration is a public gathering to protest or show support.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a kingdom or country ruled by a king or queen'?
explanation: Monarchy is correct - M-O-N-A-R-C-H-Y. A monarchy is a state ruled by a king or queen.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the power held by the people'?
explanation: Sovereignty is correct - S-O-V-E-R-E-I-G-N-T-Y. Sovereignty is the supreme power or authority of a state.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the process of making a new law'?
explanation: Enactment is correct - E-N-A-C-T-M-E-N-T. Enactment is the process of passing and making a bill into law.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'rule by a small privileged group'?
explanation: Oligarchy is correct - O-L-I-G-A-R-C-H-Y. An oligarchy is government by a small group of powerful people.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a government that controls everything'?
explanation: Totalitarian is correct - T-O-T-A-L-I-T-A-R-I-A-N. A totalitarian government exercises complete control over citizens.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'official power given to a representative'?
explanation: Mandate is correct - M-A-N-D-A-T-E. A mandate is the authority given to an elected government by voters.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a formal accusation of a public official'?
explanation: Impeachment is correct - I-M-P-E-A-C-H-M-E-N-T. Impeachment is a formal process to charge a public official with wrongdoing.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a meeting of all members of a government body'?
explanation: Plenary is correct - P-L-E-N-A-R-Y. A plenary session is one attended by all members of a governing body.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a state without a king or queen'?
explanation: Republic is correct - R-E-P-U-B-L-I-C. A republic is a country where citizens elect their leaders.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a person who holds public office'?
explanation: Official is correct - O-F-F-I-C-I-A-L. An official is a person who holds an authorized position. Double F.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'basic rights held by all people'?
explanation: Fundamental rights is correct - F-U-N-D-A-M-E-N-T-A-L R-I-G-H-T-S. These are the basic rights guaranteed to every citizen.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a set of rules for a country'?
explanation: Constitution is correct - C-O-N-S-T-I-T-U-T-I-O-N. A constitution is the supreme law of a country.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the act of joining together to form a whole'?
explanation: Unification is correct - U-N-I-F-I-C-A-T-I-O-N. Unification is the process of uniting separate parts into one.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a policy of not taking sides'?
explanation: Neutrality is correct - N-E-U-T-R-A-L-I-T-Y. Neutrality means not taking part in a conflict or disagreement.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the area under a government rule'?
explanation: Territory is correct - T-E-R-R-I-T-O-R-Y. Territory is an area of land under the control of a particular government. Double R.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a refusal to accept a law or government?
explanation: Opposition is correct - O-P-P-O-S-I-T-I-O-N. Opposition means resistance or disagreement with those in power. Double P.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a vote by the people on a question'?
explanation: Referendum is correct - R-E-F-E-R-E-N-D-U-M. A referendum is a direct vote by citizens on a specific issue.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'power shared between national and state governments'?
explanation: Federalism is correct - F-E-D-E-R-A-L-I-S-M. Federalism is a system where power is shared between central and regional governments.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the removal of a law or punishment'?
explanation: Abolition is correct - A-B-O-L-I-T-I-O-N. Abolition is the act of formally ending a law or practice.
